text:
sam: FYI eu-central1b started showing a bunch of GPU attach failures ~5m ago. 'waiting for scratch' is the common error. anyone seeing NVMe saturation? :grimace:
ops-bot: ALERT: pool eu-central1b scratch_iops_utilization > 90% for 8m. attach_fail_rate 12%. affected: gpu-provisioner, k8s-scheduler.
vivek: jumping in. running `nvme top` and `iostat -xm 1 4` now. initial glance: /dev/nvme1n1 avg await 40-120ms, util 98-100%. curious overlap with nightly ephemeral-cleaner window (which normally runs at 02:00 UTC).
tess: that window was moved earlier this week for slot reclamation (to reduce evening tail) 1:50 UTC. looks like an autoscale burst + cleaner overlap. we may have accidentally turned off the cleaner jitter for this region to debug a bug.
leo: can we throttle cleaner concurrency quickly? also maybe short-circuit deep-verify for nodes with attach-traffic.
vivek: quick mitigations I can apply from control plane: reduce cleaner concurrency, mark cluster annotation `cleaner.pause=true` for the nodepool, and add an attach admission rule to prefer nodes with free_scratch_slots >=3. will do a canary on eu-central1b-a first.
sam: post the exact commands you run so ops can track. customers reporting queued jobs.
vivek: running now:
```
# reduce concurrency
kubectl -n infra patch configmap ephemeral-cleaner --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"1","deepVerify":"false"}}'
# annotate nodepool to skip cleaner
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-instance-template nodepool-euc1b --update-labels=cleaner-pause=true
# attach admission
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"name":"attach-scratch-gate","expr":"free_scratch_slots>=3"}'
```

ops-bot: CHANGE: ephemeral-cleaner concurrency set to 1 by vivek at 4260006810. Rollback window: 4260007440 if attach success rate does not improve.
leo: i also added a temporary scheduler weight to avoid picking nodes with scrub_scheduled_in < 600s. helps steer attaches to healthier nodes.
tess: monitoring: attach queue depth dropped from 140->28 in 90s in the canary AZ. latency to attach dropped from 6.2s -> 1.1s median.
vivek: rolling to other AZs with 20s spacing. note: there's a potential follow-up spike when we unpause cleaners; suggest gradual re-enable with jitter and limit 1 concurrent deep-verify per-az.
sam: agree. create incident task to revert the policy change after 30m and to audit why cleaner jitter was disabled. also action item to have scheduler consult per-node iops_budget metric instead of only free_scratch_slots.
leo: cost note: pausing deep-verify will push more work later and may increase IO on off-peak; but it's cheaper than customer impact today.
tess: i'll update runbook and add an automated dashboard to surface scrub start times per-az. set owner infra/storage.
vivek: rollout complete at 4260006859. will monitor for 15m and then start staged re-enable with `scrub_jitter_seconds=900`.
ops-bot: NOTE: attach success rate now 98% in eu-central1 region. incident severity downgraded to P2 at 4260006865.
sam: thanks everyone. please keep this thread for updates and paste postmortem checklist items here when ready. :thumbsup:
